templates.description: They've been feeling unclear or anxious about where the relationship is heading long-term, more uncertainty than any specific complaint.

waysIn.title: Invite the conversation, don't avoid it
waysIn.description: Avoiding this topic usually makes the uncertainty worse, invite an open conversation about the future rather than letting it stay unspoken.
waysIn.action: Ask them directly what's making the future feel uncertain, and be open to what they say.

templates.subScenario: Missing How The Relationship Used To Feel
templates.title: wishing for that old spark
templates.description: They've been comparing the relationship now to how it felt earlier on, and missing some of that earlier energy or ease.

waysIn.title: Bring back something from earlier on
waysIn.description: Instead of dismissing the comparison, actively try recreating something specific from earlier in the relationship that they might be missing.
waysIn.action: Recreate an early-relationship tradition or activity you haven't done in a while.

templates.title: built different, together
templates.description: You two have been moving in sync on your ambitions lately, both putting in real effort and both leveling up in your own lane. It's the kind of couple energy people quietly notice and admire.

templates.title: always onto the next thing
templates.description: You two have both been in an exploratory mood lately, more open than usual to trying something new, and that energy is clearly working for both of you.

templates.title: leveling up, side by side
templates.description: You two have both been in a real growth stretch lately, actively working on becoming better versions of yourselves, and there's a shared momentum in that even though the specifics are your own.

templates.title: both thriving in the group chat era
templates.description: You two have both been in a socially active stretch, energized by the people around you and clearly getting a lot out of your friendships right now.

templates.title: both building something on the side
templates.description: You two have both been putting real energy into personal projects or creative pursuits lately, each quietly in your own zone of focus and momentum.

templates.title: cozy and completely fine with it
templates.description: You two have both settled into a quieter, more low-key stretch lately, content with staying in and keeping things simple rather than chasing plans.

templates.title: main characters, both of you
templates.description: You two have both been in a confidence-building stretch lately, feeling more comfortable in your own skin and it's showing in how you carry yourselves.

templates.title: busy, but somehow winning
templates.description: You two have both had a lot going on lately, packed schedules and moving pieces everywhere, but somehow you're both still riding a genuinely good wave through it.

templates.title: both in your feelings, in a good way
templates.description: You two have both been in a reflective, introspective stretch lately, thinking more deeply than usual about life, meaning, and where things are headed.

templates.title: both on fumes right now
templates.description: You two have both been running low on energy lately, each carrying your own exhaustion, and there's not much left over for each other by the time you're actually together.

waysIn.title: Rest doesn't have to be solo
waysIn.description: Two depleted people trying to recover alone rarely helps either of you, low-key time together might restore more than time apart right now.
waysIn.action: Plan the lowest-effort version of togetherness this week, no plans, no pressure, just shared downtime.

templates.title: same house, different timelines
templates.description: You two have both been feeling a bit out of sync with each other lately, busy in your own directions, with less overlap in your day-to-day than usual.

waysIn.title: Sync your schedules on purpose
waysIn.description: This kind of drift usually isn't about anything wrong, just misaligned timing, deliberately carving out overlap matters more right now than waiting for it to happen naturally.
waysIn.action: Pick one recurring time slot this week that's protected just for the two of you.

templates.title: life's throwing a lot at both of you
templates.description: You two have both been hit with a fair amount of external chaos lately, different sources, similar intensity, and there's not much calm to hand each other right now.

waysIn.title: Lower the stakes at home
waysIn.description: When everything outside feels chaotic, home doesn't have to add to it, try to keep things simple and low-drama between you while everything else settles.
waysIn.action: Agree to keep one part of your routine together completely stress-free this week.

templates.title: both a little guarded lately
templates.description: You two have both been more emotionally closed off than usual, less sharing, less openness, even though nothing specific seems to have caused it.

waysIn.tag: Lower One Wall At A Time
waysIn.title: Someone has to go first
waysIn.description: Mutual guardedness tends to reinforce itself, one small, low-stakes moment of openness from either of you could be enough to shift it.
waysIn.action: Share one honest, small thing with each other today, nothing heavy, just real.

templates.title: both stuck in your own heads
templates.description: You two have both been caught in cycles of overthinking lately, replaying things, second-guessing decisions, each looping privately instead of untangling it together.

waysIn.title: Say the loop instead of looping alone
waysIn.description: Two people overthinking separately just doubles the noise, saying what's actually on your mind out loud to each other might quiet it faster than working through it solo.
waysIn.action: Ask each other directly what's been on repeat in your heads lately, and just listen without trying to fix it yet.

templates.title: both measuring up to someone else
templates.description: You two have both been caught up in comparing yourselves to other people lately, and the quiet self-doubt that comes with it is showing up in how you each carry yourselves.

waysIn.title: Turn comparison into connection
waysIn.description: You're both fighting a similar invisible battle right now, naming that out loud to each other might feel less isolating than carrying it separately.
waysIn.action: Tell each other one thing you're each secretly comparing yourselves against, and remind each other why it isn't the full picture.

templates.title: both patching something up
templates.description: You two have both been in a phase of processing guilt or making amends about something, individually working through your own version of needing to repair or forgive.

waysIn.title: Let your repairs meet in the middle
waysIn.description: You're each doing your own internal work right now, checking in on where the other one is in that process might help you land in the same place instead of just separately moving on.
waysIn.action: Ask each other honestly whether there's anything still unresolved between you that hasn't been said yet.

templates.title: both running low on patience
templates.description: You two have both been quicker to react and slower to let things go lately, small things landing bigger than they normally would on both sides.

waysIn.tag: Call A Truce On Small Stuff
waysIn.title: Let the small things stay small
waysIn.description: When both people are short-fused at once, minor friction escalates fast, agreeing to let the little things go for now might prevent bigger blowups.
waysIn.action: Name out loud when either of you is running low on patience today, before it turns into snapping.

templates.title: both feeling alone, side by side
templates.description: You two have both been carrying a sense of loneliness lately, even while together, like something about feeling truly connected has been missing from both sides.

waysIn.title: Name it instead of coexisting through it
waysIn.description: When you're both quietly lonely at the same time, it's easy to assume the other person is fine, saying it out loud might be the fastest way to actually close the gap.
waysIn.action: Tell each other honestly that you've been feeling this way, and just sit with that together for a bit.

templates.title: both drifting, no clear direction
templates.description: You two have both been feeling a bit directionless lately, going through the motions without a strong sense of where either of you, or you as a couple, is actually headed.

waysIn.title: Pick a tiny point to move toward together
waysIn.description: Big direction doesn't need to be solved right now, choosing one small, shared thing to look forward to might be enough to shift out of neutral.
waysIn.action: Pick one small thing to plan together in the next couple of weeks, just to give you both something to move toward.

templates.title: one's out, one's in, both are good
templates.description: One of you has been out in the world lately, soaking up social energy, while the other has been content keeping things quiet and low-key, and the two paces have been balancing each other out nicely.

templates.title: one's steady, one's riding the waves
templates.description: One of you has been holding steady and grounded lately, while the other has been navigating something more turbulent, and that stability has clearly been something to lean on.

templates.title: one's grinding, one's hyping it up
templates.description: One of you has been deep in focused effort toward something that matters to you, while the other has been right there cheering it on, and that combination has been fueling real momentum.

templates.title: one's talking it out, one's tuned in
templates.description: One of you has had more to say and process out loud lately, while the other has been genuinely present to listen, and that exchange has been working well for both of you.

templates.title: one's imagining, one's building
templates.description: One of you has been in a big-picture, possibility-driven headspace lately, while the other has been steadily handling the practical details, and together that combination covers a lot of ground.

templates.title: one's exploring, one's holding it down
templates.description: One of you has been out trying new things and pushing into unfamiliar territory, while the other has been steadily keeping things stable and consistent, giving the other something reliable to come back to.

templates.title: one's still thinking, one's ready to go
templates.description: One of you has been taking time to sit with and think through something, while the other has already moved into action mode, and the pairing has been working rather than clashing.

templates.title: one's healing, one's holding space
templates.description: One of you has been moving through something difficult lately, while the other has had the steadiness and capacity to show up fully for them, and that support has clearly mattered.

templates.title: legally, all good now
templates.description: A legal or official matter they'd been dealing with finally got resolved, and the relief of it being settled is bigger than the outcome itself.

waysIn.title: Acknowledge how much this was carrying
waysIn.description: Legal or official stress carries a specific kind of weight, make sure they know you understood how much it was actually weighing on them.
waysIn.action: Ask how it feels now that it's officially settled.

templates.title: officially official
templates.description: They secured an official approval or status they'd been working toward, and there's real satisfaction in finally having it locked in.

waysIn.title: Treat the paperwork win as a real one
waysIn.description: Official milestones can feel anticlimactic since they're mostly paperwork, make sure it still gets treated like the accomplishment it is.
waysIn.action: Ask what this officially getting sorted now makes possible.

templates.subScenario: Stuck in a Legal or Official Process
templates.title: stuck in legal limbo
templates.description: They're stuck waiting on a legal or official process that's taking longer than expected, and the uncertainty of the timeline is wearing on them.

waysIn.title: Be steady through the uncertainty
waysIn.description: Waiting on something official is its own specific kind of stressful, be a calm presence through the limbo instead of speculating on timelines.
waysIn.action: Check in on how they're holding up with the wait, not just for updates.

templates.title: paperwork problem, unwanted
templates.description: Some unexpected legal or official issue landed on them, and the stress of dealing with something serious and unfamiliar is clearly weighing on them.

waysIn.title: Be calm, not alarmed
waysIn.description: Your reaction shapes how big this feels to them, stay grounded and steady rather than mirroring any panic back at them.
waysIn.action: Offer to help research next steps or sit with the paperwork together.

templates.title: the system said no, unfairly
templates.description: An official process didn't go the way it should have, and the frustration of feeling like the outcome was unjust is sitting with them.

waysIn.title: Don't rationalize it for them
waysIn.description: This isn't a moment to explain why the system works the way it does, let the frustration be fully justified without smoothing it over.
waysIn.action: Let them vent fully about how unfair it feels, without trying to find the silver lining.
